#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: I lost?! No! I refuse to be bested by this pathetic weakling!
You: Just deal with it. Having feelings isn’t being weak. You are the weak one. Closing your heart just to not get hurt is not the way to go.
Landlord: Believe what you want! Every betrayal, every loss will make me stronger!
Landlord: You buried me for now, but I’m still there, weakened, but not killed!
Landlord: A time will come when you will reach out to me yourself. When things become unbearable, you will seek help, and I will be there, waiting for you…
